Here's my own tip. "Login" is a noun or adjective (e.g. "Go to the login page"). "Log in" — two words — is a verb. So your login button should say "Log In", not "Login." (See this article for more: http://grammarist.com/spelling/log-in-login/ )

I see this all the time. It may seem pedantic, but this sort of grammar error makes a site seem less professional. For that matter, it's never a bad idea to have a professional proofreader or copy-editor go over all your UI or website copy.
